PARI-242 · Profile simulation flow, left→right, top→bottom.
1 New entry in the account dropdown (System Admin only).
2 Search by email/name; admins and inactive accounts are not selectable.
3 Explicit confirmation warning that actions write real data + audit.
4 Persistent orange banner (--ac-orange-1) above the navbar, avatar swaps to the simulated user, End simulation always one click away.
